title: Isolation precautions

findings.where: Images 1, 6 and 7, airborne-scene particles; isolation.jsx AIR_DOTS
findings.title: Airborne particles are too faint in the light theme
findings.problem: The 1.1-unit-radius particles use labInk at 75% opacity over the teal gradient, producing approximately 2.9:1 contrast near the scene's bottom. At phone width these roughly two-pixel dots are difficult to distinguish, weakening the visual explanation of suspended particles.
findings.fix: Make the airborne particles opaque and use a darker existing palette token where necessary. Check the composited contrast across the entire gradient and visibility at 320px width.

assessment: No clinical blocker found in the isolation content or its rendering logic. One light-theme graphical-contrast defect.
